purpose: Round-3 correction (maintainer finding on c1ac7237): the retained position-0 observation corpus proves token/logit output but NOT the GPU/backend execution identity behind it. Observation tokens equal to the canonical stream cannot prove the intended GPU/backend was used (the quarantined relative-ICD CPU-fallback incident shows wrong-environment execution is real; token equality is not identity proof). This pin prospectively authorizes the minimum bounded observation-only position-0 recollection WITH mechanically-captured execution receipts BEFORE any collection occurs. The round-2 pin (schema /1, bytes retained under pos0/) did not carry selector authority — it is superseded by this pin; the round-2 pos0 raw bytes remain retained under pos0/ as superseded-unbound evidence.

quarantine_record.incident: first round-2 B launch used a RELATIVE VK_ICD_FILENAMES (nvidia_icd.json); the loader found no device and the server fell back to CPU (server log: no usable GPU found). Response tokens deviated from canonical B - non-perturbation contract tripped; run stopped and quarantined at inferswarm01:/tmp/is234r/quarantine-pos0-CPU-run/ BEFORE any use. This incident is the demonstrated risk class motivating the execution-receipt requirement.

superseded_round2_disposition: The round-2 pos0 corpus (A/B/C jsonl+f32+resp+server logs collected 2026-09-21 under the /1 pin) remains retained; its rows are byte-identical to the round-3 recollection when the recollection reproduces them, and it is reclassified superseded-unbound (no execution identity). Only execution-receipt-bound observation bytes feed terminal authority.
